copyOverrides.replace: Never raced and not sure where to start? Start here. Everything on this site is built for the HYROX-curious as much as the podium-chasers — free race tools, honest talk, and a crew who remember their first finish. Come say it on Instagram; they actually answer.

copyOverrides.replace: Weekly group session · monthly meetup — class first, then coffee and treats (the important part, honestly) · starter programme in the app · crew WhatsApp group. Walkers welcome — the podium's a bonus.

copyOverrides.replace: content="Got a race ticket, need a partner? Post your card on the Race to Frame match board — first name and pace only — and we intro you to a HYROX partner at your level. Open, pro and mixed doubles, relay teams and race-trip company across the UK."

copyOverrides.replace: Booked flights and a hotel for your next race? Post your trip — others can join in: same flight, same hotel, split a room, or just travel to the venue together. Nothing booked yet? Post anyway — join someone's trip. Gregor & Hattie makes the intro, your number stays private.

copyOverrides.pattern: content="Delapan stasiun kelar[^"]*"
copyOverrides.replace: content="Eight stations done — one more: dinner. The race-crew table is the G&H meetup: race-weekend dinners and post-race hangs for athletes, participants and the HYROX-curious. The dance floor is optional. RSVP so there\u2019s a chair for you."

copyOverrides.pattern: Delapan stasiun kelar\. Satu lagi: makan\.
copyOverrides.replace: Eight stations down. One more: dinner.

copyOverrides.pattern: Station 9 itu meja makan[\s\S]*?Yang penting rame\.
copyOverrides.replace: The ninth station is the dinner table. Race-weekend meetups — athletes, racers and the HYROX-curious all welcome. And after away races, Sunday night: a busy restaurant, race stories, laughing. Not fine dining. Loud is the point.

copyOverrides.pattern: HYROX itu delapan stasiun[\s\S]*?rencana\.
copyOverrides.replace: HYROX has eight stations. The ninth station — a dinner table full of people who get why your legs are wrecked. No pace requirement, no partner needed, don't even need to have raced. If you're just curious you're the most welcome of all — sit down, eat, hear the stories, leave with a plan.

copyOverrides.pattern: Yang kakinya masih berfungsi[\s\S]*?menang\.
copyOverrides.replace: Legs still working? Carry on to the dance floor. Legs not working? Sit down — the gossip continues either way. Both count as winning.

Coming back from a layoff
  1. Drop intensity before volume — keep the sessions, cut the load. The habit is the hard part; the fitness comes back.
  2. Race doubles first. Splitting the stations means you can go hard for 30 seconds and recover — banking confidence instead of a blow-up.
  3. A plan beats guesswork. Ask G&H — that's what the coaching page is for.
